# Curry and Grill

> Curry and Grill is a family-run Indian restaurant at 722 W National Rd in Vandalia, Ohio, serving North Indian curries, tandoori grills, biryanis and fresh naan, with a lunch buffet Tuesday to Sunday ($18.95 adults, $12.95 children). Dinner is served from 4:30 PM; closed Mondays. Every curry can be made mild, medium or hot; there is a full vegetarian section, vegan options and a full bar. Rated 4.8 from 313 Google reviews.

## Visit
- Address: 722 W National Rd, Vandalia, OH 45377
- Phone: (937) 280-4448 (also (937) 626-9854)
- Email: Mrverma2@yahoo.com
- Hours: Monday closed. Tuesday–Friday 11:00 AM–2:30 PM and 4:30–9:30 PM. Saturday–Sunday 11:30 AM–3:00 PM and 4:30–9:30 PM.
- Lunch buffet: Tuesday–Friday 11:00 AM–2:30 PM, Saturday–Sunday 11:30 AM–3:00 PM. $18.95 adults, $12.95 children.

## Menu
- Curries: Chicken; Lamb & Goat; Vegetarian; Seafood
- Tandoor & Biryani: From the Tandoor; Biryani & Rice
- Starters: Appetizers; Vegetarian Appetizers; Soups & Salads
- Breads & Sides: Breads; Sides
- Desserts & Drinks: Desserts; Drinks

## Good to know
- Curries can be made mild, medium or hot.
- Full vegetarian section and vegan options; full bar with beer, wine and cocktails.
- Free parking; wheelchair-accessible entrance, seating and restroom.
